activation: dedicated actual enrollment/custody and reviewed exact source implementation/writer manifest; all refund paths mediated; no production registration supplied
canonical: recursive ordinal-key sorted compact UTF8 JSON; arrays ordered; null preserved; native canonicalSha256
failure: all lookup/read/replay execute=false refundEntitlement=false retryAllowed=false; unknown/lost/rollback/expired/revoked never release identity or permit another key; absence explicitly no retry

identifiers.items.amountMinor: net amount for the entire quantity, not unit price; discount already allocated
identifiers.items.shopifyLineItemId: Shopify line-item numeric REST ID canonical decimal
identifiers.paymentId: Shopify original transaction numeric REST ID canonical decimal
identifiers.scopeChanges: never normalize values; immutable conflicts fail; new registration cannot release order fence
identifiers.shopifyOrderId: Shopify order numeric REST ID canonical decimal
identifiers.storeId: Shopify shop numeric REST ID, canonical decimal, not domain/handle/GID

inventory: Exact currentReservation authenticates own reservation bookkeeping excluded from evidence/refundInventory. No effect or uncertainty is excluded even for this intent; all other reservations/effects remain blocking. Source acceptance verifies projection and serialization.
linearization: source durable PREPARED->REDEEMING before native SQLite immediate first reservation; SENDING commit before provider; revoke-first denies, reserve-first irrevocable; no distributed cancellation
receipt: fresh authenticated intent; immutable original binding; current evidence may show effects/changed inventory, never reuse it for eligibility; SUCCESS requires sending fence+exact association/attempt/payment/refund transaction SUCCESS+providerReceiptHash; unknown may lack association/attempt/outcome; terminal rollback/failed audit noRetry:true UNKNOWN may retain authenticated partial provider IDs/commitments without success; audits distinct from prepare/redeem/send and ordered after latest fence. FOUND/non-null and ABSENT/null enforced.

routes.service: GET /api/exact-refund/verifier/authorities/:authorityId; POST /associations; POST /associations/lookup; GET /associations/:associationId; POST /receipts/:associationId empty body

timing: 15s observations; authority <=15min and minimum all credential/custody/acceptance expiries; no observation renews durable expiry
transport: dedicated source reader bearer, HTTPS pinned origin, no queries/redirects/fallback; dedicated native CF JWT audience+common_name and bearer+X-Exact-Refund-Registration-Id
